leadText:
The Sunflora Lodge (Japanese: ペンションキマワリ Pension ) is an -exclusive location in Johto. It appeared in Moving Pictures and is located in between Ecruteak City and Olivine City.

It is most likely called this because Sophia and Marcello, the two who run the lodge, live here and take their anniversary photograph with hundreds of every year. The wooden construction is at least fifty years old. It was visited by , , , and while they were trying to defrost a after an flew past.

Sunflora Lodge is surrounded by open fields and lies to the south of a mountain range that includes Snowtop Mountain.
